item.title: Report: Netanyahu turned down 11 chances to kill Hamas leader Sinwar in 2023
item.description: Quoting senior official, Israeli TV says in February and March of that year, Shin Bet repeatedly suggested taking Sinwar out, but PM refused to even discuss it; PMO denies report The post Report: Netanyahu turned down 11 chances to kill Hamas leader Sinwar in 2023 appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: New York man charged with hate crime for punching rabbi on Holocaust Remembrance Day
item.description: Eric Zafra Grosso allegedly shouted against Jews before assaulting victim, is now facing up to 4 years in prison The post New York man charged with hate crime for punching rabbi on Holocaust Remembrance Day appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Vance faces bipartisan criticism for omitting Jews in Holocaust Remembrance Day statement
item.description: Statements from other Trump administration officials and the White House mention Jews and antisemitism, which the US vice president has been hesitant to condemn among conservatives The post Vance faces bipartisan criticism for omitting Jews in Holocaust Remembrance Day statement appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: 2026 state budget passes first reading in Knesset with partial Haredi support
item.description: MKs vote 62-55 in favor of budget with some $262 billion in total expenditures; Shas and Degel HaTorah come out in favor after last-minute negotiations over draft exemption bill The post 2026 state budget passes first reading in Knesset with partial Haredi support appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Trump wants to create conditions for ‘regime change’ in Iran — US sources
item.description: Sources say US president weighing options that include targeted strikes, much broader attack * EU ministers expected to list IRGC as terror organization, impose new sanctions on Iran The post Trump wants to create conditions for ‘regime change’ in Iran — US sources appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Her ancestors were expelled from Spain. Now she’s bringing bagels to Madrid
item.description: After proving ancestry and getting Spanish citizenship, Tamara Cohen found herself in a Jewish food desert. Her restaurant, Mazal, is providing a nosh for Jews and non-Jews alike The post Her ancestors were expelled from Spain. Now she’s bringing bagels to Madrid appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Israel says Hamas may soon cede Gaza to technocrats, but will keep grip on Strip

item.title: Driver smashes car into Chabad’s world headquarters in New York City
